title: Recruitment role staff CRUD on APES CIC
summary: Staff on APES CIC can create, edit, publish, and close recruitment roles (staff, volunteer, and student) from the Recruitment hub, replacing the Wave 0 stub with real role management.
changes: Add the RecruitmentRole model, migration, factory, and policy with draft, open, and closed lifecycle states.
Ship staff CRUD under the APES CIC Recruitment hub with list and create anchors, plus publish and close transitions.
Gate role create and updates to staff abilities so guests and public service users cannot mutate roles.
Cover staff happy-path CRUD, unauthorized denial, and hub quick links with feature tests.
version_rationale: Patch release on the v0.34.x line: staff RecruitmentRole CRUD builds on the 0.34.0 registry without changing the public board or applications yet.
validation: PHPUnit RecruitmentRoleWorkflowTest, ModuleRegistryTest, ServiceHubQuickLinksTest, and JobRoleCapabilityPacksTest pass for role CRUD and staff-only create.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: The public roles board and application review are not included; those ship in later 0.34.x patches.
Recruitment remains APES CIC only (not Shelter or Pet Care Clinic).
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove RecruitmentRole CRUD routes, views, and the recruitment_roles table migration from the live app.
provenance: RecruitmentRole staff CRUD for issues #213 and #220, pull request #242.
